invariants.rationale: A new HoodieJavaWriteClient is returned, which should never be null.
The return type is BaseHoodieWriteClient and HoodieJavaWriteClient extends this.
Config is required to construct the HoodieJavaWriteClient.
Context is required to construct the HoodieJavaWriteClient.
The method always returns an instance of HoodieJavaWriteClient.
